key_insight: A roll-to-roll optical in-line imaging setup can simultaneously resolve multiple transparent film thicknesses and birefringence in real time.
engineering_relevance: This enables fast, non-destructive process monitoring for thin-film fabrication in organic solar cell manufacturing and quality control.
method: Uses an optical imaging setup integrated into a roll-to-roll deposition line.
Measures free films or films on thicker transparent substrates.
Resolves thickness from 0.3 to 110 micrometers and can also estimate birefringence.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a proof-of-concept demonstration on PEDOT and ZnO materials relevant to organic solar cells, showing the method’s measurement range and applicability.
watch_item: Performance is demonstrated as a proof of concept, so robustness across many material systems and production conditions still needs validation.
paper_title: Resolving multiple layer thicknesses and birefringence in thin films with an optical in-line Roll-to-Roll characterization setup
